mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contract_payout ( payout_id, policy_number, calculation_basis, payment_type, paid_premium_amount, refund_rate, calculated_amount, deduction_item, deduction_amount, final_payment_amount, payout_status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{payoutId}, #{policyNumber}, #{calculationBasis}, #{paymentType}, #{paidPremiumAmount}, #{refundRate}, #{calculatedAmount}, #{deductionItem}, #{deductionAmount}, #{finalPaymentAmount}, #{payoutStatus}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT payout_id, policy_number, calculation_basis, payment_type, paid_premium_amount, refund_rate, calculated_amount, deduction_item, deduction_amount, final_payment_amount, processor, payout_status, created_at, approved_at, paid_at, cancelled_at FROM contract_payout WHERE payout_id = #{payoutId}

SELECT payout_id, policy_number, calculation_basis, payment_type, paid_premium_amount, refund_rate, calculated_amount, deduction_item, deduction_amount, final_payment_amount, processor, payout_status, created_at, approved_at, paid_at, cancelled_at FROM contract_payout WHERE policy_number = #{policyNumber} ORDER BY created_at DESC
